---
description: "Re-scan previously audited documents and show what improved"
mode: agent
agent: document-accessibility-wizard
---

Re-scan all documents that appear in the most recent audit report. Compare the new scan results against the previous findings.

For each document, classify every finding as:
- **Fixed** -- was in previous report, now resolved
- **New** -- not in previous report, appears now  
- **Persistent** -- remains from previous report
- **Regressed** -- was previously fixed but has returned

Show the overall score delta and per-document score changes. Highlight documents that improved and any that regressed.
